availability.rule: a source result is usable at start + result_lag_hours (per competition, conservative); golf at end date + 1 day + lag; Kalshi-only results at the latest Kalshi settlement_ts of the event; unfinished events never update ratings

bootstrap.resample_unit: cluster (source game / fight / tournament / Kalshi event)

params.field_assumption: field = entrants listed in the source result (published pre-event; late withdrawals included)

exclusions: Kalshi void / fair-price or unsettled markets

contracts whose spec fails the reconciliation gate (independent payoff must reproduce Kalshi settlement on >= 98% of pre-test settled markets; if fewer than 30 pre-test markets exist, all settled markets are used, which compares two outcome sources but no forecasts)
individual contracts where the independent payoff disagrees with Kalshi settlement
ambiguous or unresolved participant / game identity (never merged automatically)
preseason games (NBA, WNBA, NFL, MLB, NHL)
scopes or competitions with too few training games to fit (reported as blocked)
player/appearance-conditioned markets are not modelled (no pregame-deployable participation data)

kalshi_benchmark.candle: hourly candle with end_period_ts <= cutoff (latest such); mid of closing yes bid/ask
kalshi_benchmark.closing_lines: NFL nflverse closing moneylines (vig removed) reported separately as post-cutoff information
kalshi_benchmark.eligibility: competitions whose game_winner test sample meets min_clusters (network budget)
kalshi_benchmark.empty_book: bid <= 0 or ask >= 1 treated as no quote
kalshi_benchmark.market_per_cluster: home-side winner market (team sports); lexicographically first ticker otherwise
kalshi_benchmark.sample: clusters ordered by sha256(protocol|competition|cluster); labels not used

label: Kalshi settlement (yes=1/no=0) for contracts passing the gate; independent outcome reported as reconciliation

metrics.skill: paired difference model - benchmark of per-contract loss, cluster bootstrap CI
